topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I stumble upon this metal box, half-buried in the soil where I know I've never planted a thing. My hands shake as I pry open the rusted lid, the contents a mystery from a past I can't recall. Old newspapers, crumbling and yellowed, photos of faces I barely recognize. A watch, its hands frozen at 3:17. What secrets do these items hold? Why did someone hide them here, and why do I feel this overwhelming urge to uncover the truth? The more I sift through, the more the air seems to thicken, pressing down on me. I need to know, I just have to.
